content: The tongue of the heart speaks without alphabet, and is understood by every soul.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Zaban-e del (زبان دل) — Rumi & Classical Mystical Lore
explanation: Words, grammar, and formal treaties can be forged, misunderstood, and twisted by deceit. But when genuine compassion, quiet presence, and sincere tears flow, the heart recognizes its native dialect across all barriers of nationality, language, and culture.
practicalInsight: Communicate with genuine warmth and heart-centered presence today rather than relying solely on clever words.
reflectionPrompt: What conversation in your life needs less analytical arguing and more of the quiet, truthful language of the heart?
